messages:
Lina: Quick sync — systems integrator activation sprint next Tue/Wed. Need to lock: training cohorts, hardware voucher flow, marketplace listing target, and joint announcement timing. Who's got blockers?
Rafa: I have a question on cert levels — do we gate 'Gold' on the hands-on lab pass or on a recorded assessment?
Maria: For capacity, we can run two 25-person cohorts (AM/PM) across both days. Hands-on lab requires infra access; recorded assessment could be optional fallback.
Samir: Infra access note — SI partners will need VPN + ephemeral creds. Can we use the existing vpn-onboard script? cc @Lina
Lina: Yes, use vpn-onboard but need a small tweak: shorten TTL for partner tokens to 8h. Also we need a simple signup form for lab requests.
Samir: I'll add a checkbox in the form for ``need-hardware-voucher`` so ops can triage.
Eli: On joint announcement: Marketing wants the marketplace listing live before the press note goes out. Target: listing by Fri EOD so we can announce Mon. Is that feasible?
Rafa: Marketplace listing depends on vendor legal intake — that can take 3–5 biz days if attachments are clean. Any chance to fast-track for a handful of SIs?
Lina: We can fast-track 3 partners if PD signs a letter. I'll draft the letter template.
Maria: Training content update: added a troubleshooting module for GPU provisioning and a short lab walkthrough (10–12 min video). Link: https://redwood.company/si-train/modules-v2
Samir: For lab infra, ops says we need SKU mapping: ``rwd-gpu-8x-rtx6000`` vs ``rwd-gpu-32x-a100``. I'll push mapping to the form.
Eli: Also need to confirm embargo window for the announcement — marketing asks for 48h review. We'll share a draft by Thu 3pm PT.
deploy-bot: calendar event created — "SI Activation Sprint: Prep" Tue 10:00 PT — invites sent to participants.
Rafa: Certification rubric proposal: Bronze = docs + quiz, Silver = live lab pass, Gold = lab pass + reference customer integration. Thoughts?
Maria: Sounds good. Add an appeals flow for failed labs (one retake within 14 days).
Samir: Ops question: hardware vouchers — who issues and what's the audit trail? I suggest a google form -> GH issue in partner-ops repo -> 2-approver signoff.
Lina: Approved process. @Rafa will draft the voucher policy, @Samir owns the form + automation, @Maria owns training schedule. I'll own the announcement timeline and fast-track list.
Eli: I'll slot the draft announcement in marketing channel on Thu AM and ping legal for the review.
Maria: One more — need a partner-facing runbook for onboarding that covers: prerequisites, VPN, lab access, voucher request, and cert paths. I'll start a doc and share the link by EOD.
Samir: Snippet for runbook (paste in doc):
```
If partner needs VPN: send email to infra@redwood.com with subject: "VPN ONBOARD: <partner-name>" including contact + expected lab window.
Include sku list and whether voucher required.
```
Rafa: pinging @Lina — do we want to include a short checklist for joint announcement assets (logo, partner quote, legal name)?
Lina: Yes — checklist: logo (svg), short 30–40 word quote, one integration screenshot, partner legal contact. I'll put that in the runbook draft.
Eli: All good from my side. If marketing gets the listing + assets, we can keep the Mon announcement.
Lina: Final action items: Rafa -> draft cert rubric & voucher policy (Due Thu noon). Samir -> create form + automation (Due Thu EOD). Maria -> runbook + schedule (Due Thu EOD). Eli -> announcement draft + legal ping (Due Thu 3pm). I'll compile and share final timeline Fri AM. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
